data.name: Diesel Burners
data.detailed_description:
Diesel Burners is an open-world sandbox set in a dieselpunk universe.
Pilot customizable aircraft, face massive enemy fleets, and explore a living island where everything can be destroyed… or rebuilt.

It combines arcade action, exploration, and deep vehicle customization in a fast, dynamic, and visually stylized experience.

Core Features

  • Arcade-style aerial combat, with precise and responsive controls.

  • Customizable vehicles with upgradable weapons, engines, and visuals to match your playstyle.

  • Destructible and rebuildable environments, with consequences that shape the world.

  • Progression system based on upgrades, collectibles, and achievements.

  • Local and online multiplayer (in development) to share the chaos with other pilots.

  • Free exploration across mountains, towns, and enemy bases on a war-torn island.

  • Distinctive dieselpunk art style, with polished low-poly visuals and immersive atmosphere.

Story & Setting

War has reached the shores of Parmesia, a region where the industrial revolution fuels both progress and destruction.
You are Pier Legrand, war hero and captain of the Diesel Burners squadron, leading the last line of resistance from a small island that serves as both base and home.

Defend your territory, rebuild what was lost, and face invading fleets and mechanical titans in battles that will test your power and precision.

The Road Ahead

The full version of Diesel Burners will include:

  • New aircraft and ground vehicles, including motorcycles and experimental units.

  • Advanced customization, both functional and aesthetic.

  • Main missions and side quests, with NPCs that react to your actions.

  • New enemies and powerful zone bosses with unique mechanics.

  • Additional power-ups, dynamic events, and new areas to unlock on the island.

  • Enhanced destruction and reconstruction systems that impact gameplay.

  • Customizable player buildings, to store and modify your vehicles.

Early Access

Diesel Burners will launch in Early Access because we want to refine every detail of the game together with the community.
Our goal is to continuously improve gameplay, balance, content, and performance to deliver the best experience possible before the final release.

Vision

Diesel Burners aims to deliver an intense, fluid, and visually striking experience, where players feel in full control of powerful machines in a stylized, ever-evolving world.
It’s a tribute to engineering, speed, and action — designed so that every session feels as satisfying as it is spectacular.

data.short_description: Open-world aerial shooter that blends fast-paced arcade combat, exploration, and deep customization. Fly freely, defend your island from invasion, upgrade your vehicles, unlock gear, and tailor each aircraft to your playstyle. A bold, replayable dieselpunk adventure.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce 8000 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
